ROW.COLUMN: This scenario monitors electronic transactions involving internal accounts, external entities, geographies, transaction channels, or transaction products that are deemed risky.
Primary Rule contains logic for alert generation and highlights. Sub-rules are used to generate building block values.

-- kumarsu on 06/15/09 : PR39952: replaced nvl with coalesce select en.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, w.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID -- The join condition was changed for improving the performance --BUG 19566952 - PERFORMANCE FIX from @MINER@.WIRE_TRXN w,@MINER@.EXTERNAL_ENTITY en where (w.ORIG_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID = en.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID or (w.ORIG_AUG_NM = en.EXTRL_NTITY_NM and w.ORIG_JRSDCN_CD = en.JRSDCN_CD))
and w.INTRL_ORIG_ACCT_FL <> 'Y' -- Include both Electronic Funds Transactions and Electronic Securities Transactions and w.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD in (@Incl_Wire_Trxn_Prdct_Type_Lst) -- PR 32608 :Effective Risk Level of the Focal Entity Performing the Transactions >= Effctv Risk Lvl -- or Activity Risk Level of the Transactions performed by the Focal Entity >= Actvty Risk Lvl and (en.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB >=@Effctv_Risk_Lvl or w.ORIG_ACTVY_RISK_NB >= @Actvty_Risk_Lvl) -- Exclude Distribution, Dividend, Fee, Interest, and Transfer-of-Account Transactions and w.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' -- Exclude Electronic Funds Transactions between Related Parties and (@Incl_Rltd_Parties ='Y' or COALESCE (w.UNRLTD_PARTY_FL,'Y') <>'N') -- Exclude Cancelled and Canceling Electronic Funds Transactions and w.CXL_PAIR_TRXN_INTRL_ID is null --Included Transaction Source Codes or All Transaction Sources and (w.SRC_SYS_CD in (@Incl_Trans_Src_Lst) or @All_Trans_Src_Fl = 'Y') -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Exclude Exempted EN and en.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 -- Getting data for look back period only and Utilize indexes --BUG 19566952 - PERFORMANCE FIX and w.TRXN_EXCTN_DT in (select cal.clndr_dt from @MANTAS@.KDD_cal cal where cal.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cal.CLNDR_DAY_AGE between 0 and @Look_Back_Period - 1) and w.DATA_DUMP_DT in (select cal.clndr_dt from @MANTAS@.KDD_cal cal where cal.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cal.CLNDR_DAY_AGE between 0 and @Look_Back_Period - 1) --OFSAABD-19350 --Included Jurisdiction Codes and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' OR en.JRSDCN_CD IN (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst))

-- kumarsu on 06/15/09 : PR39952: replaced nvl with coalesce select en.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, w.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID -- The join condition was changed for improving the performance --BUG 19566952 - PERFORMANCE FIX from @MINER@.WIRE_TRXN w,@MINER@.EXTERNAL_ENTITY en where (w.SCND_ORIG_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID = en.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID or (w.SCND_ORIG_AUG_NM = en.EXTRL_NTITY_NM and w.SCND_ORIG_JRSDCN_CD = en.JRSDCN_CD))

Focal entity activity risk level at or above to be considered for an alert.
Minimum focal entity effective risk level at or above to be considered for an alert.
Minimum aggregate transaction amount required for an alert. A focal entity may qualify for an alert by meeting either the minimum threshold for aggregate transaction amount or count.
Minimum total transaction count required for an alert. A focal entity may qualify for an alert by meeting either the minimum threshold for aggregate transaction amount or count.
Number of calendar days specified for the lookback period.
Number of calendar days specified for the frequency period.
List of transaction source codes that the scenario covers. The client defines the allowable values.

Parameter that allows the coverage of all transaction source codes without enumerating them in the Included Transaction Source Codes threshold: Y: Covers all transaction source codes regardless of the Included Transaction Source Codes threshold value. N: Covers only those transaction source codes that are listed in the Included Transaction Source Codes threshold.

List of Transaction Product Type Codes for Wire transactions included by the scenario. Allowable values are defined in the Mantas Transaction Product Type Codes field of the Wire Transaction file as described in the Transaction Code Values section and Transaction Supplementary Guidance section of the DIS
This parameter allows the coverage of all transactions between related parties: Y: Covers all transactions. N: Excludes transactions between related parties.

Parameter that allows the coverage of all jurisdictions without enumerating them in the Included Jurisdiction Codes threshold: Y: Covers all jurisdiction codes regardless of the Included Jurisdiction Codes threshold value. N: Covers only those jurisdictions that are listed in the Included Jurisdiction Codes threshold value.
The list of jurisdiction codes that the scenario covers. The client defines allowable values.
